one_line: Chief minister of Travancore under Marthanda Varma, architect of its 18th-century centralized state.

appearance.age_look: mid-40s, lean and wiry with a disciplined posture and the build of someone used to travel and long hours of work
appearance.face: oval face with a sharp jawline, wheatish-brown complexion, straight prominent nose, thin lips, and intense, calculating eyes with slightly dark under-eyes; a small neatly trimmed black moustache; default expression is calm, observant seriousness with a hint of strategic confidence, softening into a respectful half-smile when addressing allies
appearance.hair: black hair oiled and drawn back into a modest Brahmin kudumi (tuft) at the back of the crown, the rest closely cropped; hairline slightly receding at the temples; no elaborate headgear, but a narrow off-white cotton angavastram edge occasionally wrapped lightly around the head in field scenes (default: resting over shoulders, not as turban)
appearance.costume: Era-accurate mid-18th century south Indian Brahmin-turned-minister attire: a pristine off-white cotton veshti (dhoti) worn in the Tamil–Travancore style, pleated in front and wrapped to ankle length with a fine golden-yellow border; upper body covered with a long-sleeved, collarless, knee-length angarakha-style jacket of unbleached handloom cotton dyed a muted indigo-blue, opening slightly at the chest with a simple tie; over the left shoulder, an off-white angavastram with a thin maroon stripe drapes diagonally and falls to mid-thigh; under the jacket, a visible sacred thread (yajnopavita) rests discreetly but never leaving the torso bare; simple leather sandals on the feet; jewellery is restrained—a single thin gold chain, small gold stud earrings, and a narrow brass ring on the right hand; a palm-leaf document roll tucked into a cloth belt at the waist hints at his bureaucratic role; overall textiles are matte, handwoven cotton and light silk-blend borders, with no ostentatious royal ornaments to stress his ministerial, not royal, status.
appearance.signature: A medium-length slim steel sword with a gently curving single-edged blade, a simple southern Indian hilt with a plain brass guard and wooden grip wrapped in dark cord, carried in a dark brown leather scabbard worn at his left side, often held in his left hand while his right hand carries a rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with red cotton string.

ref_desc: Ramayyan Dalawa is a mid-40s lean Tamil Brahmin minister with wheatish skin, sharp oval face, small black moustache, oiled hair in a back kudumi, wearing an off-white veshti with golden-yellow border, indigo-blue cotton jacket, off-white angavastram with maroon stripe, simple gold accents, and carrying a slim curved steel sword in a brown scabbard plus a tied palm-leaf manuscript bundle in a restrained off-white, indigo, golden-yellow, maroon and dark-brown palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Ramayyan Dalawa, the mid-18th century Tamil Brahmin minister of Travancore: a mid-40s, lean and wiry man with wheatish-brown complexion, sharp oval face, straight nose, small neatly trimmed black moustache and intense, thoughtful eyes. His black hair is oiled and drawn into a modest kudumi tuft at the back with closely cropped sides and a slightly receding hairline. He wears a pristine off-white ankle-length veshti (dhoti) in Tamil–Travancore style with a fine golden-yellow border, and a long-sleeved, collarless, knee-length indigo-blue cotton angarakha-style jacket over his covered torso; the sacred thread is subtly suggested under the jacket without exposing his chest. An off-white angavastram with a thin maroon stripe drapes from his left shoulder diagonally across his body, falling to mid-thigh. Show simple leather sandals, a thin gold chain, tiny gold stud earrings, and a narrow brass ring on his right hand, avoiding any royal-level ornamentation. At his waist, tuck a small palm-leaf document roll into a cloth belt, and in his hands show his signature items: a medium-length slim curved steel sword with a plain brass hilt and dark cord-wrapped wooden grip in a dark brown leather scabbard at his left side, and a rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with red cotton string in the other hand. Use a restrained palette of off-white, indigo blue, golden yellow, maroon and dark brown, and present him in neutral, front, side and back views with a calm, observant expression that hints at strategic intelligence and administrative authority.
